import unicodedata

def norm_email(e, strip_plus):
    e = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", e.strip()).lower()
    if strip_plus:
        local, _, dom = e.partition("@")
        e = local.split("+")[0] + "@" + dom
    return e

def resolve_principal(db, tenant, app, keys, policy):
    rules = [("idp_subject", keys.idp_subject), ("scim_id", keys.scim_id)]
    if keys.email and keys.email_verified:          # unverified email is a claim, not a key
        rules.append(("verified_email", norm_email(keys.email, policy.strip_plus)))
    hits = {}
    for rule, value in rules:
        if not value:
            continue
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT DISTINCT principal_id FROM principal_index "
            "WHERE tenant_id=%s AND rule=%s AND key=%s", (tenant, rule, value)).fetchall()
        if len(rows) > 1:                           # a key that hits two people is poison
            hits[rule] = None
        elif rows:
            hits[rule] = rows[0][0]
    found = {v for v in hits.values() if v}
    if None in hits.values() or len(found) > 1:     # tricky part: any disagreement maps nothing
        db.execute("INSERT INTO identity_conflict(tenant_id,app,app_user_id,candidates) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                   (tenant, app, keys.app_user_id, json.dumps(hits)))
        return None
    if not found:
        return None
    p = found.pop()
    first = next(r for r, _ in rules if hits.get(r))
    db.execute("UPDATE principal_map SET superseded_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=%s AND app=%s AND app_user_id=%s AND superseded_at IS NULL",
               (tenant, app, keys.app_user_id))
    db.execute("INSERT INTO principal_map(tenant_id,app,app_user_id,principal_id,match_rule) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
               (tenant, app, keys.app_user_id, p, first))
    return p

import hashlib, json

def refresh_acl(db, bucket, adapter, bus, tenant, app, doc_id):
    if not bucket.take(app, tenant, points=adapter.points_per_read, share=0.5):
        raise Backoff(app)                            # ACL share of the quota is spent: wait
    entries = adapter.read_acl(tenant, doc_id)        # list of (principal, role)
    entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: (e.principal, e.role))
    h = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([[e.principal, e.role] for e in entries]).encode()).hexdigest()
    row = db.execute("SELECT acl_hash, entries FROM object_acl_state WHERE tenant_id=%s AND app=%s AND doc_id=%s",
                     (tenant, app, doc_id)).fetchone()
    if row and row[0] == h:
        return AclRefresh(False, [], entries)         # same list: stop, no downstream work
    old = {e["principal"] for e in (row[1] if row else [])}
    removed = sorted(old - {e.principal for e in entries})
    db.execute('''INSERT INTO object_acl_state(tenant_id,app,doc_id,acl_hash,entries)
                  VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
                  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,app,doc_id) DO UPDATE
                  SET acl_hash=EXCLUDED.acl_hash, entries=EXCLUDED.entries, fetched_at=now()''',
               (tenant, app, doc_id, h, json.dumps([e.__dict__ for e in entries])))
    if removed:                                       # tricky part: revocations travel the fast lane first
        bus.publish("acl.revoke", {"tenant": tenant, "app": app, "doc": doc_id, "principals": removed})
    bus.publish("acl.entries", {"tenant": tenant, "app": app, "doc": doc_id, "entries": [e.__dict__ for e in entries]})
    return AclRefresh(True, removed, entries)

INLINE_MAX = 64

def put_acl(db, index, bus, tenant, doc_id, ver, principals, group_refs):
    cur = db.execute(
        '''INSERT INTO object_acl(tenant_id,doc_id,acl_version,principals,group_refs)
           VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
           ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,doc_id) DO UPDATE
             SET acl_version=EXCLUDED.acl_version, principals=EXCLUDED.principals,
                 group_refs=EXCLUDED.group_refs, updated_at=now()
           WHERE object_acl.acl_version < EXCLUDED.acl_version''',
        (tenant, doc_id, ver, principals, group_refs))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        return False                                  # stale: a newer list already applied
    inline = principals[:INLINE_MAX]
    payload = {"acl_ref": f"{tenant}:{doc_id}", "acl_version": ver, "acl_inline": inline}
    chunk_ids = [r[0] for r in db.execute("SELECT chunk_id FROM chunk WHERE tenant_id=%s AND doc_id=%s", (tenant, doc_id))]
    for i in range(0, len(chunk_ids), 500):           # tricky part: patch metadata only, never re-embed
        index.set_payload(chunk_ids[i:i+500], payload)
    bus.publish("acl.applied", {"tenant": tenant, "doc": doc_id, "version": ver})
    return True

def delete_acl(db, tenant, doc_id):                   # called on an erase order
    db.execute("DELETE FROM object_acl WHERE tenant_id=%s AND doc_id=%s", (tenant, doc_id))
